review.note: Approved one by one in define-gate slot G3-16 of the resolution-recipe-eval package (REQ-224 exception (b)); the docs PR carrying the answered slot merged 2026-10-10.

question: When my Murder resolves and both Blood Artists trigger, each of us targeting the other player, which of us wins?

expected.shortAnswer: Player 2 wins: their trigger resolves first and you lose at 0 life.
expected.answer: Player 2 wins. Both Blood Artists trigger when Grizzly Bears dies. As the active player you put your trigger on the stack first, and Player 2 puts theirs on top (603.3b), so Player 2's trigger resolves first and you go from 1 life to 0. State-based actions are checked before anyone gets priority (704.3), and you lose the game at 0 life (704.5a) before your own trigger can resolve.

whyHard: Triggers go on the stack in active-player-first order, so the other player's trigger resolves first, and state-based actions are checked before the active player's trigger can resolve.
